parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 suggests structural overlap between `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 164), these are distinct test scenarios — one asserts a core state invariant after stop, the other asserts idempotency of play-after-stop — and their near-duplication is intentional test-fixture phrasing rather than accidental redundancy. Merging or extracting them into shared production code would couple test semantics into the production `Playback` package, which is the canonical restraint pattern.
